notes.title: A Very Scary "Hot Launch" On Christmas Day
notes.notes:
So to start off my city is Nashville TN, we were hit on Christmas day by a insane bomber. More on that after the main news:

Don't Crash - The Zombie Game 
Is now available on Steam! With a 40% discount. This is the second game in the series and I hope it keeps going based on sales.
"Money makes the world go around"
With that being said I hope to do bundle deals on this game.
More furry games are planned as well! At least one will bed made, possibly 3 are in idea mode haha.

[b]
DISCLAIMER BEFORE YOU KEEP READING:
THIS IS MY OPINION AND A LOT IS NOT FACT. PLEASE DO YOUR OWN RESEARCH, I'M NOT YOUR MOMMY! I'M NOT CHOOSING YOUR OPINION. IF YOU CAN'T UNDERSTAND THAT PLEASE STOP READING AND GO TO BED.[/b]

About the bombing. Wow scary way to wake up. Luckily he missed the batman building, the main skyline of Nashville. I'm not making conspiracy but its a strange coincidence that it was removed from flight sim exactly 31 days earlier. Hes also a tech nerd that was 60+ years old. That's quite some experience probably. The game also updates from BING (lol) maps.... So I don't think he worked for Microsoft but maybe he was able to remove it on bing maps. Things like that are easier than it sounds.... Luckily he killed himself but our city is in shock. I'm not the strongest person on earth. But I keep finding myself crying. Scared. 

I think even steam is recovering. Based on this:
Valve partnered with several companies, including AT&T, Acer, and GameSpy. The first mod released on the system was Day of Defeat.[12] In 2002, the president of Valve, Gabe Newell, said he was offering mod teams a game engine license and distribution over Steam for US$995.[12] - Wikipedia.com 

Again this is my OPINION and NOT a fact. Nothing is true till its proven in a crime. In USA we have a wait for facts policy, that almost no one follow thanks to Facebook.

Video of me in flight sim:
https://youtu.be/n_PkL3X_QDs

Please, don't support me. If you're still reading. Take that dollar, 49 cents, whatever your about to spend... On a Nashville recovery donation pool. Local companies were hurt, the largest losing millions. AT&T is the clear biggest loser here.

With that horrible news being said obviously AT&T will recover. But local tech companies are hurt. Our city needs repair. COVID-19 is number one in the world here at points. If it wasn't a COVID/5g conspiracy nut I will "eat my shorts" on live stream.

Thank you for your support of both Nashville, and my games.
Lets hope 2021 MIGHT not suck.

My friend I worked with to save up for this precious career path made a donation link
https://m.facebook.com/nt/screen/?params=%7B%22fundraiser_campaign_id%22%3A785809051999902%2C%22source%22%3A%22messenger%22%7D&path=%2Ffundraiser%2F

Here are some more donation links in no particular order:
https://nashvillerescuemission.org/ways-to-give/donate-now/
https://thriftsmart.com/donate-goods-2/
https://www.childrenshospitalvanderbilt.org/information/donate-items-childrens-hospital
